title: Notes HTTP JSON API with persistence
brief: Build a small HTTP JSON API for personal notes. POST /notes with {title, body} creates a note and returns 201 with the stored note including an integer id (ids are sequential starting at 1). GET /notes/{id} returns the note or 404. GET /notes?q=term lists notes whose title contains the term (case-insensitive). DELETE /notes/{id} returns 204. Notes must survive a restart of the service.
spec: The service stores notes durably so that a process restart loses nothing. Titles are required and non-empty; bodies may be empty. The list endpoint returns a JSON array ordered by id ascending and filters on a case-insensitive substring of the title only, never the body. A deleted note answers 404 on every later read and never reappears in listings. Ids are never reused after a delete within the lifetime of the data. Error responses are JSON objects with an error field.

recovery.description: The service process is killed and restarted from its persisted state right after the second note is created.
